prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right attorney depends on your case facts, injuries, insurance limits, and whether you want a trial lawyer or a negotiator. I can help you find top attorneys for your situation if you tell me a ZIP code and a few case details (injuries, fault dispute, severity).

How to pick the best lawyer for your car wreck
- Experience with car wrecks and serious-injury cases (not just general practice). Look for trial experience and a record of significant settlements/verdicts.
- Track record: past settlements/verdicts, peer reviews, client reviews.
- Resources: firm needs investigators, medical experts, and the ability to advance litigation costs.
- Communication: responsive, clear explanations of strategy and likely outcomes.
- Fees: most PI lawyers work on contingency. Ask the percentage, who pays court/medical costs up front, and what happens if you don’t recover.
- Chemistry and trust: you should feel comfortable with the attorney who will represent you.

Where to search and verify credentials
- Super Lawyers, Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell for ratings and reviews.
- Texas Bar (Find a Lawyer) and Houston Bar Association to verify license and disciplinary history.
- Look for “Board Certified” in Personal Injury Trial (Texas Board of Legal Specialization) — that’s a strong indicator of focused trial expertise.

Key questions to ask at a free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the results?
- Do you try cases or settle most matters?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your contingency fee and what costs are deducted if we recover?
- How long do you expect this case to take?
- How will you manage medical bills, liens, and care while my case is pending?

Typical fee & timeline expectations
- Contingency fees commonly 33%–40%. Some firms charge less if the case settles before a lawsuit or if they take it to trial — always confirm in writing.
- Small, straightforward claims may settle in a few months; serious injury cases commonly take 1–2 years (or longer if a trial is needed).

If you want a shortlist
Tell me:
- Your ZIP code (or neighborhood in Houston)
- A brief case summary (severity of injuries, disputed fault, major medical bills)
I’ll pull together a short list of well-rated Houston personal injury lawyers who handle car wrecks and explain why each may fit your case.
